panels.description: Debit and credit transaction shares of all matching transactions.

targets.rawSql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT trans_type FROM expenses.main.acc_labelled WHERE trans_type IN ('debit', 'credit') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}' = 'NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}' = 'NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)) SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'debit') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS "Debit transactions", COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'credit') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS "Credit transactions" FROM filtered

panels.title: Transaction Mix

panels.description: Debit spend and credit income as shares of total matching transaction amount.

targets.rawSql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT trans_type, trans_amt FROM expenses.main.acc_labelled WHERE trans_type IN ('debit', 'credit') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}' = 'NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}' = 'NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)) SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'debit') / NULLIF(SUM(trans_amt), 0), 0) AS "Debit spend", COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'credit') / NULLIF(SUM(trans_amt), 0), 0) AS "Credit income" FROM filtered

panels.title: Amount Mix

panels.description: Savings rate is (credit income minus debit spend) divided by credit income. Negative values mean spending exceeded income.

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        trans_type,
        trans_amt,
        LOWER(TRIM(category)) AS category,
        LOWER(TRIM(subcategory)) AS subcategory
    FROM expenses.main.acc_labelled
    WHERE
        trans_type IN ('debit', 'credit')
        AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt)

        AND (
            '${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL'
            OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})
        )

        AND (
            '${category:raw}' = 'NULL'
            OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})
        )

        AND (
            '${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL'
            OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})
        )

        AND (
            '${entity:raw}' = 'NULL'
            OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})
        )

        AND trans_amt BETWEEN
            TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE)
            AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)
)

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        100.0 * (
            SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (
                WHERE trans_type = 'debit'
                  AND category = 'investments'
            )
            -
            SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (
                WHERE trans_type = 'credit'
                  AND category = 'investments'
            )
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (
                WHERE trans_type = 'credit'
                  AND subcategory = 'salary'
            ),
            0
        ),
        0
    ) AS "Savings rate"

FROM filtered;

panels.title: Savings Rate

panels.description: Daily credit and debit totals over the dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('day', trans_dt) AS DATE) AS "date",

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN trans_type = 'debit'
        THEN trans_amt ELSE 0 END
    ) AS "Spend",

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN trans_type = 'credit'
        THEN trans_amt ELSE 0 END
    ) AS "Income"

FROM expenses.main.acc_labelled

WHERE
    trans_type IN ('debit', 'credit')
    AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt)

    AND (
        '${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL'
        OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})
    )

    AND (
        '${category:raw}' = 'NULL'
        OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})
    )

    AND (
        '${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL'
        OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})
    )

    AND (
        '${entity:raw}' = 'NULL'
        OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})
    )

    AND trans_amt BETWEEN
        TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE)
        AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)

GROUP BY 1

ORDER BY 1 DESC;

panels.description: Monthly income minus spending over the selected dashboard range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', trans_dt) :: TIMESTAMP AS time,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN trans_type = 'credit' THEN trans_amt
      WHEN trans_type = 'debit' THEN (-1 * trans_amt)
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS "Net Cash Flow"
FROM
  expenses.main.acc_labelled
WHERE
  trans_type IN ('credit', 'debit')
  AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt)
  AND (
    '${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL'
    OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})
  )
  AND (
    '${category:raw}' = 'NULL'
    OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})
  )
  AND (
    '${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL'
    OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})
  )
  AND (
    '${entity:raw}' = 'NULL'
    OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})
  )
  AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE)
  AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1

panels.description: Missing values in key manual-label fields across the selected date range.

targets.rawSql: WITH debit_rows AS (SELECT category, subcategory, normalized_trans_src, trans_mode FROM expenses.acc_labelled WHERE trans_type = 'debit' AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt)), field_values AS (SELECT field, value FROM debit_rows CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('category', category), ('subcategory', subcategory), ('normalized source', normalized_trans_src), ('payment mode', trans_mode)) AS fields(field, value)) SELECT field, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value IS NULL OR TRIM(value) = '') AS missing_rows, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value IS NULL OR TRIM(value) = '') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS missing_percent FROM field_values GROUP BY field

panels.title: Data Quality

targets.rawSql: WITH categorized AS (SELECT trans_type, trans_amt, CASE WHEN trans_amt < 100 THEN 'Under ₹100' WHEN trans_amt < 200 THEN '₹100–199' WHEN trans_amt < 500 THEN '₹200–499' WHEN trans_amt < 1000 THEN '₹500–999' WHEN trans_amt < 2000 THEN '₹1,000–1,999' WHEN trans_amt < 5000 THEN '₹2,000–4,999' WHEN trans_amt < 10000 THEN '₹5,000–9,999' WHEN trans_amt < 25000 THEN '₹10,000–24,999' ELSE '₹25,000+' END AS amount_band, CASE WHEN trans_amt < 100 THEN 1 WHEN trans_amt < 200 THEN 2 WHEN trans_amt < 500 THEN 3 WHEN trans_amt < 1000 THEN 4 WHEN trans_amt < 2000 THEN 5 WHEN trans_amt < 5000 THEN 6 WHEN trans_amt < 10000 THEN 7 WHEN trans_amt < 25000 THEN 8 ELSE 9 END AS band_order FROM expenses.acc_labelled WHERE trans_type IN ('debit', 'credit') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}' = 'NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}' = 'NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)) SELECT amount_band, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'debit') AS "Spend", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'credit') AS "Income" FROM categorized GROUP BY amount_band, band_order ORDER BY band_order

panels.description: Debit subcategories appearing in at least three distinct months; this is a recurrence signal, not proof of a subscription.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(subcategory), ''), 'Uncategorized') AS subcategory, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', trans_dt)) AS months_active, COUNT(*) AS debit_transactions, ROUND(AVG(trans_amt), 2) AS average_spend, ROUND(SUM(trans_amt), 2) AS total_spend FROM expenses.acc_labelled WHERE trans_type = 'debit' AND subcategory IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}' = 'NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}' = 'NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', trans_dt)) >= 3 ORDER BY months_active DESC, total_spend DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent Transactions

panels.description: Monthly debit spend compared with the Monthly budget input. Set a value greater than zero; this comparison follows the selected dashboard filters. Positive variance means over budget.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', trans_dt) AS month,
    SUM(trans_amt) AS actual_spend
  FROM
    expenses.acc_labelled
  WHERE
    trans_type = 'debit'
    AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt)
    AND (
      '${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL'
      OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})
    )
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' = 'NULL'
      OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})
    )
    AND (
      '${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL'
      OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})
    )
    AND (
      '${entity:raw}' = 'NULL'
      OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})
    )
    AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE)
    AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)
  GROUP BY
    1
),
budget AS (
  SELECT
    TRY_CAST(${monthly_budget} AS DOUBLE) AS amount
)
SELECT
  STRFTIME(month, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  ROUND(actual_spend, 2) AS actual_spend,
  CASE
    WHEN budget.amount > 0 THEN ROUND(budget.amount, 2)
  END AS monthly_budget,
  CASE
    WHEN budget.amount > 0 THEN ROUND(actual_spend - budget.amount, 2)
  END AS variance,
  CASE
    WHEN budget.amount > 0 THEN ROUND(
      100.0 * (actual_spend - budget.amount) / NULLIF(budget.amount, 0),
      1
    )
  END AS variance_percent
FROM
  monthly
  CROSS JOIN budget
ORDER BY
  month DESC

panels.title: Monthly Budget vs Actual

panels.description: Debit spending by calendar month for the year chosen in the Comparison year dropdown versus the prior year. Ignores the dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT
    TRY_CAST(${yoy_year:raw} AS INTEGER) AS yr
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    trans_dt,
    trans_amt
  FROM
    expenses.acc_labelled
    CROSS JOIN sel
  WHERE
    trans_type = 'debit'
    AND YEAR(trans_dt) IN (sel.yr, sel.yr - 1)
    AND (
      '${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL'
      OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})
    )
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' = 'NULL'
      OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})
    )
    AND (
      '${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL'
      OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})
    )
    AND (
      '${entity:raw}' = 'NULL'
      OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})
    )
    AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE)
    AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)
)
SELECT
  STRFTIME(MAKE_DATE(2000, MONTH(trans_dt), 1), '%b') AS month,
  SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (
    WHERE
      YEAR(trans_dt) = sel.yr
  ) AS "Selected year",
  SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (
    WHERE
      YEAR(trans_dt) = sel.yr - 1
  ) AS "Prior year"
FROM
  filtered
  CROSS JOIN sel
GROUP BY
  MONTH(trans_dt)
ORDER BY
  MONTH(trans_dt)

panels.title: Year-over-Year Monthly Spend

panels.description: Debit merchants active in at least three distinct months. Monthly activity and amount variability are heuristic signals; candidates are not guaranteed subscriptions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT normalized_trans_src AS merchant, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', trans_dt)) AS active_months, COUNT(*) AS debit_transactions, ROUND(SUM(trans_amt), 2) AS total_spend, ROUND(SUM(trans_amt) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', trans_dt)), 0), 2) AS average_monthly_spend, ROUND(AVG(trans_amt), 2) AS average_transaction, ROUND(100.0 * STDDEV_SAMP(trans_amt) / NULLIF(AVG(trans_amt), 0), 1) AS amount_variability_percent, MIN(trans_dt) AS first_seen, MAX(trans_dt) AS last_seen FROM expenses.acc_labelled WHERE trans_type = 'debit' AND normalized_trans_src IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(normalized_trans_src) <> '' AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}' = 'NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}' = 'NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}' = 'NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}' = 'NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY normalized_trans_src HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', trans_dt)) >= 3 ORDER BY active_months DESC, total_spend DESC LIMIT 50
